# Cache Module

**Status:** Future — not implemented in v0.1.

This module will provide content-based caching using BLAKE3 hashing to avoid redundant task execution.

Planned components:
- `ICacheBackend` — abstract cache interface
- `ContentHashCache` — BLAKE3-based content-addressable cache

## Dependencies
- Core
- Task

No files compiled. Directory exists to reserve namespace.
